decisionsTitle: Volunteers from 14, with a parent's or guardian's agreement, on a page of their own
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-14.** About 08:25: «voluntarii trebuie să aibă cel puțin 14 ani, nu 18». Then: «atunci fă cu acord ceva» — an agreement for the under-18 — «și formularul trebuie să fie pagină separată, nu embedded în pagina evenimentului». And at 17:05, when the dispatcher asked questions: «it's YOLO man» — decide the open points and say what was decided.

Amends §754 (the form on the event's page), §758 (the volunteer agreement, its single-use link and paper record, its PDF) and §765 (the age box, `VOLUNTEER_MINIMUM_AGE` = 18).

**The age.** `VOLUNTEER_MINIMUM_AGE` is 14, one constant of the platform, and `VOLUNTEER_ADULT_AGE` 18. Decided: no club setting. The club did not ask to vary it, and a different number is Legea nr. 78/2014's question — a line of code and a release, not a box in «Setări». The age box refuses 13 with «Voluntarii trebuie să aibă cel puțin 14 ani»; 14–17 only with a guardian (below); 18 and over alone. The organizers' hand entry follows the same rule: a person under 14 is refused, one of 14–17 needs the parent's name (the address only if the organizer has it — the consent may be taken on paper).

**The guardian's agreement.** A person of 14–17 offers on the public form with «Numele părintelui sau tutorelui», «Emailul părintelui sau tutorelui» and the tick «Părintele sau tutorele meu știe și e de acord» (the volunteer's own act each time; a typed address and name come back after a refusal, the tick never). The boxes are the island `GuardianFields`: drawn open and with nothing `required` on the server, so scripts off and an adult both work, and shown or hidden from the age typed once the page hydrates. The service drops whatever an adult typed in them and keeps nothing of it. The guardian then accepts **the same volunteer agreement in their own name**: an email with a single-use link goes to their address at the sign-up (and again at an organizer's «Trimite linkul părintelui»); the link is §758's flow for a second person — minted when the email renders, only its SHA-256 kept on the row, the page it opens a read that never writes (AGENTS.md §12.8), the POST spending it in the statement that records the acceptance — and the typed name is the acceptance, with the version, the moment, the language, the blanks and the fingerprint of the text read (§556), the same proof §758 keeps. Or the organizers tick «Acordul părintelui pe hârtie» at the desk: the sheet printed (`?for=guardian`) carries the volunteer's line and the parent's, the record names who recorded it, the stale-sheet refusal is §758's (`VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT_REPRINT`), and the audit says the way, never a name. The columns are `guardian_*` on `event_volunteers` and an enum `volunteer_guardian_method` (LINK | PAPER), migration `0152_volunteer_guardian`, expand only.

**«Acordul părintelui lipsește».** A minor's row says it until the guardian accepts; «Confirmă» is refused with the same sentence (`VOLUNTEER_GUARDIAN_MISSING`). Giving a role and cancelling are not held up: the consent is a condition of being confirmed, not of being listed. A volunteer whose age is changed to 18 or more, or to none, loses the guardian's data — name, address, acceptance, link — in the same save (the trail says `guardianCleared`); a guardian who has accepted is not renamed or readdressed under their acceptance. A volunteer entered by hand with an age under 18 has their own agreement link without the age tick (their parent accepts beside them), and their acceptance is never recorded as «declared of age».

**The guardian's data is a third person's, so the gate is both texts.** The club takes a person under 18 only while the privacy notice in force names `{{volunteerMinors}}` **and** the volunteer agreement in force names `{{volunteerGuardian}}`, each in every language (`volunteerMinorsOpen`, §562's and §613's pattern, with the second text because the guardian accepts it). Until then a typed age under 18 is refused on the age's own box with «Clubul nu primește încă voluntari sub 18 ani», the organizers' entry refuses it too, the guardian's verbs refuse (`VOLUNTEER_MINORS_CLOSED`), and `/admin/tasks` carries the row `volunteerMinorsTexts`. §758's form, with its tick, asks no age and takes adults only whatever the texts say. The templates only change — the texts in force never move; the §639 email tells the Administrators — and `SETUP.md` §44 step 8 is the sitting. The notice's volunteers paragraph names the guardian's name and address, why they are kept (to ask the agreement: art. 6(1)(f), and 6(1)(b) for the acceptance), who sees them and that they stay with the volunteer's own row, 30 days after the event; the agreement gains four sentences that name the guardian and drop whole for an adult — the consent and the minor's confirmation only after it, activities suited to the age and no night or dangerous posts, the guardian's data, how the guardian accepts. The guardian's address is mailed unproven, so it has a throttle of its own, three an hour, beside the volunteer's.

**For the lawyer, not decided here — and read before the club approves.** Legea nr. 78/2014 has its own rules on the age and the consent of minors who volunteer. Whether 14 is the right floor; whether a parent's typed name on a single-use link is the form of consent it asks, or the paper copy is needed; what «activități potrivite vârstei» must exclude; whether the club must keep the guardian's consent beyond the 30 days the platform deletes the row after; and whether a guardian who is on no list is told enough by the email's privacy line (art. 14 GDPR). The templates say so in their headers.

**The volunteers' own page.** The form moves to `/ro/evenimente/<slug>/voluntari` and `/en/events/<slug>/volunteers` (the routing's pathnames map): «Vreau să fiu voluntar la <eveniment>», the event's date and place in one line, the roles that still need people with their rich descriptions and how many places each has, the form with every box of §754 and §765 and the guardian's, the agreement's and the notice's links. Served as the registration page is served — `force-dynamic`, `noindex`, the sealed draft cookie read only after a refusal, the render time the bot check counts from — so it is on the per-request list of `static-public-routes.test.ts`, never prefetched, disallowed in `robots.txt`, and not in the sitemap, which lists no form page (neither `/inscriere` nor `/declaratie`). It answers **404 while the form could not be sent** — the event is not published, is for the members alone, is cancelled or over, takes no volunteers, no role needs people, the privacy notice or the agreement in force does not describe them — never a form that cannot work; the one exception is a person reading the answer to their own post when the last place was given away meanwhile, who still reads «am primit». A post to a form closed meanwhile goes to the event's own page, not to the 404. The thank-you is on that page, by the house's redirect-with-flash (§427): the banner the address asks for and a toast (`volunteerSent`). One read, `readVolunteerOffer`, serves the page and the event page's box, so a box that says «Căutăm voluntari» never leads to a 404.

**The event's page** keeps one line, «Căutăm voluntari: <roles that still need people>», and one button «Vreau să fiu voluntar» (a glyph, 44 pixels, not prefetched) under the same gates; the embedded form, its draft cookie and its `?volunteer=` answer are gone from it, which also takes `form-draft.ts` out of what a static public page reaches (the allow-list of `static-public-routes.test.ts` shrinks) and `volunteer` and `vfields` out of the live twin's keys.

**The emails and the PDF.** One new type, `VOLUNTEER_GUARDIAN_REQUEST`, to the guardian, greeting nobody by the child's name, with its own privacy line («cineva te-a trecut ca părinte sau tutore»). Decided: no copy to the guardian — the volunteer's copy of the agreement is sent again, once the guardian accepts, with both acceptances on the PDF, and the card keeps the guardian's PDF for the staff; whether the guardian should also get their own copy is a question for the lawyer's pass, one more email type. The volunteer's «am primit» says their parent was asked. The PDF of a minor has a second signer: the volunteer's line and the guardian's (the organizer's line is for an adult's desk copy), the guardian's version, blanks and fingerprint when they accepted, and «încă neprimit» while they have not; an adult's PDF is unchanged. The CSV gains three columns after the T-shirt (the guardian, their address, the consent as «Da»/«Nu»), and «Toate datele unei persoane» lists the guardian with the volunteer's row.

**Refused.** A club setting for the minimum age (a constant, said above); a table of guardians (the data is the volunteer's row's and goes with it); the guardian's acceptance by a tick on the volunteer's own form (a child cannot give their parent's consent); a staff-signed consent (CLAUDE.md: a staff member records a signature, never gives one); sending the guardian's link by itself when an organizer enters a minor by hand (the organizer chooses: the address may be missing and the consent on paper); a minor's offer with no notice or agreement describing it (the gate); keeping the form in a fold on the event's page beside a page of its own.

**Open for the owner.** Whether the guardian should receive their own copy of the agreement they accepted (one more email type); whether the 30-day deletion is long enough for the guardian's consent — the same question as §758's register of agreements.
changelogLine: - **Volunteers from 14, with a parent's consent, on a page of their own** — the age floor is 14; a person of 14–17 offers with a parent's or guardian's name and address and is confirmed only after the parent accepts the agreement from a single-use link or on paper («Acordul părintelui lipsește» until then), once a privacy notice and an agreement that describe minors are approved; the form is `/evenimente/<slug>/voluntari` (404 while it could not be sent) and the event's page keeps one line and one button. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 37. Given an event that takes volunteers, when a visitor types an age, then 13 is refused on the age's own box with «Voluntarii trebuie să aibă cel puțin 14 ani», 14 to 17 are taken only with the parent's or guardian's name and a valid address and the volunteer's tick that the parent knows and agrees (each refusal naming its box: `guardianName`, `guardianEmail`, `guardianAware`) — the boxes drawn open and with no `required` on the server, so the form works with scripts off and for an adult, and shown by the age typed once the page hydrates — and 18 and over are taken alone, whatever was typed in the guardian's boxes dropped and kept nowhere; and while the privacy notice in force does not name `{{volunteerMinors}}` or the volunteer agreement in force does not name `{{volunteerGuardian}}`, in every language, an age under 18 is refused on `age` with «Clubul nu primește încă voluntari sub 18 ani», the organizers' entry refuses it too, and §758's form, which asks no age, takes adults only (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 33. Given an event that takes volunteers, then its form is the page `/ro/evenimente/<slug>/voluntari` (`/en/events/<slug>/volunteers`) — «Vreau să fiu voluntar la <eveniment>», the event's date and place in one line, the roles that still need people with their descriptions and how many places each has, the form, the agreement's links — served per request and never indexed, answering 404 while the form could not be sent (the switch off, no role needing people, the event not published, for the members alone, cancelled or over, the notice or the agreement in force not describing volunteers) except to a person reading the answer to their own post; the thank-you is on that page by a redirect with a flash toast and never on the event's page, which keeps one line «Căutăm voluntari: <roles>» and one 44-pixel button «Vreau să fiu voluntar» under the same conditions and no form, no draft cookie and no `?volunteer=` answer; a post to a form closed meanwhile goes to the event's page (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer under 18 with a guardian's address, when the sign-up is kept or an organizer presses «Trimite linkul părintelui», then one email is queued to that address with no secret in it, and the link is minted when it is sent, its SHA-256 alone on the volunteer's row; its page reads and writes nothing; accepting — the tick and the typed name, each refused apart — spends it in the statement that records the acceptance, so a second press, a second tab, an expired link, a replaced one, a cancelled volunteer's or one no longer under 18 finds nothing (one answer), and an address corrected while the email waited withdraws the message and mints nothing for the old mailbox (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 130. Given the event's «Voluntari» card, then a volunteer under 18 shows «Acordul părintelui lipsește», «Link trimis părintelui» or «Acordul părintelui primit» with the parent's name and address on the row, and «Confirmă» is refused with `VOLUNTEER_GUARDIAN_MISSING` until the guardian has accepted, from the link or on paper — an adult is never held up; «Trimite linkul părintelui» (only with an address), the PDF to sign and «Acordul părintelui pe hârtie» (after a question, naming who recorded it, refused when the sheet printed is not the version in force) wait while the notice and the agreement in force do not both describe minors; the entry asks the parent's name for an age under 18, refuses 13, and an age of 18 or more clears the guardian's data; a guardian who accepted is not renamed or readdressed; the CSV and the person's data carry the guardian (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 68. Given the privacy notice's and the volunteer agreement's templates, then the notice's volunteers paragraph names the minors, the guardian's name and address (`{{volunteerMinors}}`, the form's two labels quoted), why they are kept, who sees them and for how long, with no number of its own, and the agreement carries four sentences that name the guardian (`{{volunteerGuardian}}`) and are dropped whole for an adult; the club takes a person under 18 only while the notice names the one and the agreement the other, each in every language, and `/admin/tasks` carries the row `volunteerMinorsTexts` until then; no text in force is changed (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 8. Given a volunteer under 18, then the agreement's PDF has a second signer — the volunteer's line and the guardian's, never the organizer's — and, once the guardian accepted, the guardian's version, blanks, typed name or paper record and fingerprint, or «încă neprimit» while they have not; the desk's sheet for the guardian is the text to sign even when the volunteer accepted their own; an adult's PDF is unchanged (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 150. Given the guardian's verbs — «Trimite linkul părintelui» and «Acordul părintelui pe hârtie» — and the PDF's `?for=guardian`, when anyone but the Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator asks, then the server refuses (`FORBIDDEN`, and 403 for the PDF), and a volunteer of another event is `NOT_FOUND` (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: volunteers from 14 with a guardian's consent, on their own page
